name: Overcoming Gluttony
overview: Scripture teaches that overcoming gluttony requires self-discipline and a heart focused on true satisfaction in God rather than earthly appetites. Proverbs warns the man given to appetite to exercise strict control, even to the point of putting a knife to his throat, highlighting the severity of this temptation. The glutton and drunkard are cautioned that their excess leads to poverty and ruin, while blessedness comes from eating in due season for strength, not for drunkenness. Ultimately, those who hunger and thirst after righteousness will be filled, pointing believers to seek spiritual nourishment above all.
